text: 2026年7月份，全国工业生产者出厂价格同比上涨3.5%，环比下降0.7%。工业生产者购进价格同比上涨5.5%，环比下降1.0%。1—7月平均，工业生产者出厂价格比上年同期上涨1.8%，工业生产者购进价格上涨2.8%。
text_en: In July 2026, the national producer prices for industrial products rose 3.5% year-on-year and fell 0.7% month-on-month. The purchase prices for industrial producers rose 5.5% year-on-year and fell 1.0% month-on-month. On average from January to July, producer prices for industrial products rose 1.8% compared with the same period last year, and purchase prices for industrial producers rose 2.8%.
